Retail inlines indexed ToAck.get in the first loop but calls get(seq,0) inside the subsequent ToAck.removeHead expansion, followed by remove(0). Baseline inlines that get; it does call remove(0). Both inline the Missing get. EH frame size agrees; profile begin/end and cleanup remain part of any final proof. The endianness helper sites are already inlined with corresponding retail operations. # 0x8551F0 CordCon::buildHeader — individual Sol escalation

Model: gpt-6.1-sol high. Claim 325, target 0x8551F0 only. No production/header/snapshot/inventory/commit/GitHub edits. Current base is bdefc60e236590ccb3ad66ca1cd02fa21d20f6e0, retained3 cordcon.cpp SHA256 66fa6026ea7e7e698a877990face746bc601eed69dbe0f6a6a450a9de420d906. The changed translation unit was compiled through runner_retained3.py using the native venv and unchanged retained3 cordmgr.obj context. All 125 current file/address and all 125 symbol/address pairs, including every original 122 pair, survive every completed input. No new pairs and no losses. Nothing qualifies for retention.

## Actual tests and outcome

Four distinct source inputs compiled once each, in two prewritten hypothesis batches. Six runner launches total: four completed compilations and two guard rejections before candidate staging/compilation. No unchanged control recompilation, compiler-invalid or semantic-invalid input. Two compiled source inputs are compiler duplicates: counter duplicates baseline; headerloads duplicates session. Three raw body groups and the same three relocation-masked pattern groups including the baseline group. No arbitrary eight-input quota was imposed: batch 2 improved the best diagnostic, but no supported distinct remaining mechanism was identified after inspection.

| Batch | Input | Source SHA256 | Executable bytes | Diagnostic rows | Actual result |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | getpointer | c96cb8a978305cc8f017fb5521f1cfbd456d02adff04910ee1c5da03e0cbd06e | 1194 | 122 | Worse; nested ToAck get still inline |
| 2 | session | c0e44c5be77743188a73eccc135a0e70ad6dfe03e3543aba7d69089a98a8ff50 | 1187 | 49 | Partial improvement from baseline 53 |
| 2 | counter | 67caae495c8b1fad4d97c36488e2a12bf4c7c5b87e2f7705dbab2131c1ac6dc1 | 1187 | 53 | Raw/masked baseline duplicate |
| 2 | headerloads | 1e9057c77b36ba9d70961ff58371aeff83b7ac60988586120e8175f2411e0c05 | 1187 | 49 | Raw/masked session duplicate |

Batch 1 used the existing real ArrayList getPointer accessor followed by an actual copy in the first indexed loop: `unsigned int *ack; if (c->ToAck.getPointer(&ack,k)) seq=*ack;`. get and getPointer use the same signed range checks. The NULL on failure affects only the local pointer, preserving seq on failure; success copies the same element once before the existing comparison/remove. The real accessor-plus-dereference idiom exists in cordcon.cpp handlePacket. This changes the actual inline tree and source cost without a dead read or fabricated wrapper. Actual output adds a LEA then separate dereference, changes function-wide registers, and fails to cut the required later nested get. The first-loop any/index allocation worsens; unchanged frame size does not make it equivalent. This result does not justify old bool retries.

Batch 2 followed exact Key_Exchange and the solved ACK/Pump load/conversion mechanism at the actual initial outgoing header operations. Naming Session before the same htons fixes baseline CX/push ECX to retail AX/push EAX, and the next counter receiver reload EDX to retail ECX: four diagnostic rows disappear. The counter load split by itself changes no executable byte. Combining both duplicates Session. The original `*counter=PacketsOut_` store and following actual `*counter` reread remain, preserving possible aliasing; htonl(0) is unchanged. This is useful partial source evidence, stored in sol/session/cordcon.cpp, not a match. All 18 actual calls remain versus retail 19: ToAck.get within removeHead is still inlined where retail calls exact unsigned get at 0x84F440. Missing's get remains inline, as in retail. No bool forms were retried.

All four bodies retain sub esp,0x350. The native EH inspection shows the same single state with predecessor -1 and one cleanup action present. Exact unsigned get remains the same 34 executable bytes, raw SHA256 526bd45e236058150771be744cc1499162ca047c2a0e890e59bf273c5a4f6c11, for baseline and all inputs. This is native comparison evidence, not a complete retail EH/referent audit. No target exactness audit is claimed.

Actual objdiff and explain files are 8551F0-objdiff.txt and 8551F0-explain.json in each run. sol/inspection.json records frames, calls, relocations, native EH predecessor/action presence and exact get body hashes.
- Raw/masked output groups: 8551F0/sol/groups.json. Baseline/counter raw 9ea47f889c8624af76375488c1094ea42fb54c2dccedad78cfbded12a749f3af, masked e7e773a045829ca9de90e9d8640c8538f06c19a092d3e6fa6c12bb23d8a56482. Getpointer raw 2cbf4549637caae6f450c5c374b8c799fa983436b98ecc578a41ee7d7f647403, masked 8d60313db6f0ec7e2e11564cf2058069f6c52060a2a54e0e351f4afdb23d0621.
- Guard launches: 8551F0/sol/launch-failures.json contains intended hashes, causes, exact stderr and successful retry run names; runs/sol_8551F0_{counter,headerloads}_guard_launch/guard.log preserves the errors. The Session runner yielded a live exec session and two following invocations were mistakenly submitted before it finished; both stopped at the immutable/staging guard, before candidate input copies or compilation. ## Relevant prior evidence and remaining limit

Read complete history/8551F0.txt and .json and current attempts.py show: 42 historical forms across three rows; exact individual historic inputs are absent except docs/attempts/8551F0/bh_077.cpp.txt. That actual stash is the current function plus two dead Active_.size reads, explicitly prohibited here. Its bool/unsigned/int tests are not new source context. Inspected both first-tier actual patches/sources/objects/diffs/groups: first_8551F0_gethead worsens to 1334/121, while first_8551F0_remove is identical baseline. Neither reproduces the needed call boundary. The three raw/masked Sol groups above are additional actual observations, not 42 reconstructed old inputs.

Read final group/report.md and actual Pump_Connections helper/lifetime replay and successful interaction records, alongside source-bound proofs docs/attempts/85A430/claim325-ack1.json, docs/attempts/85ABB0/claim325-ack2.json, and docs/attempts/858A60/claim325-pumpconn-proof.json. ACK1's coordinated real conversion splits motivated batch 2. ACK2's raw slot fix requires its real con block ending after both adds before delete; zero normalized rows alone was insufficient. Pump_Connections needed the real existing helper to hold construction/scope plus complementary actual protocol/XMP locals. buildHeader has no corresponding new/add/delete sequence. These results do not authorize arbitrary scopes or repeated flag coloring here.

Inspected actual ArrayList get/getPointer/remove/removeHead/getHead definitions and types, exact unsigned get machine code, and exact CordCon::pump at 0x853560. The latter already calls get then remove from its removeHead loop, preserving the genuine layered helper mechanism; its real message temporaries and call tree differ from buildHeader. Existing udpconn Find_Ptr and ui_manu nested helpers demonstrate depth sensitivity, but do not identify another actual supported operation to add here.

A source-local unsigned get specialization through getPointer was considered but never generated or compiled. The actual pointer-accessor trial adds a LEA rather than retaining get's exact direct scaled-load shape, while changing the existing helper raises specialization visibility/ODR and all-consumer questions. It has no demonstrated preservation or useful new outcome warranting a broader experiment; root did not approve it. Shared-header rewrites remain untested and require a concrete semantic/source mechanism plus root's all-consumer plan. Arbitrary wrappers/dead reads, fake lifetimes, flags/pragmas, remove-result changes and old bool loops were rejected. No fully generated source proposal remains uncompiled.

Reopen on actual helper/accessor/source evidence that reproduces retail's selective nested ToAck.get call while preserving exact get and all consumers, or a demonstrated real lifetime mechanism for the retail flag/n/index allocation. Session's improved allocation alone leaves the same inline mismatch and does not reopen old any-type forms. This is bounded exhaustion of supported leads after meaningful tests, not a claim that every equivalent C++ program was searched.

Compiler/staging gate explicitly released after all jobs completed. Both pristine and staging cordcon.cpp equal the retained3 source hash; no worker compiler/runner jobs or leases remain. Root owns attempt rows, integration and any further gate.
